component.name: OrcaMCP
component.summary: OrcaSlicer with an MCP server, so an AI assistant can drive it

screenshot.caption: A model ready to be sliced on a buildplate.
A calibration test ready to be printed out.

description.p: OrcaMCP is a fork of OrcaSlicer that embeds a Model Context Protocol server, so an AI assistant can load models, change print settings, slice, and send jobs to a printer through the same application a person uses by hand. Everything runs locally; no cloud service is involved.

It keeps everything OrcaSlicer offers - advanced calibration tools, adaptive layer heights, tree supports, multi-material support, and network printing for compatible printers - and adds a live device console for FlashForge Creator 5 and Creator 5 Pro toolchangers.
See the release page for detailed changelog.
